target_definition: 1 if 2R target (3x entry-ATR) is hit before 1.5x-ATR stop within 48 bars (4h) of the decision bar, else 0 (stop-first or timeout).
notes: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR LIVE/PAPER USE. Walk-forward validation (see docs/AI_LAYER.md) shows this modeling approach does not improve on the existing strategy: rejected-vs-accepted trades show no meaningful win-rate separation, and the existing ConfidenceScorer score itself shows no monotonic relationship to forward outcome in this proxy. Saved for reproducibility only. AI_ENABLED must remain false until a materially different feature set / target shows real discriminative power on out-of-sample data.
